{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01U1Dbr9nKeCVATbQysRGTqp","type":"tool_result","content":"f594cdf Build block-1: ARCHITECTURE.md [built]\n7e0d42e Checkpoint before drydock build commonmark\n---\nmdparser\nmdparser/blocks.py\nmdparser/cli.py\nmdparser/entities.py\nmdparser/inlines.py\nmdparser/refs.py\nmdparser/render.py\nmdparser/__init__.py\nmdparser/__pycache__\nmdparser/__pycache__/blocks.cpython-312.pyc\nmdparser/__pycache__/cli.cpython-312.pyc\nmdparser/__pycache__/entities.cpython-312.pyc\nmdparser/__pycache__/inlines.cpython-312.pyc\nmdparser/__pycache__/refs.cpython-312.pyc\nmdparser/__pycache__/render.cpython-312.pyc\nmdparser/__pycache__/__init__.cpython-312.pyc\ntests\ntests/conftest.py\ntests/test_foundation.py\ntests/__pycache__\ntests/__pycache__/conftest.cpython-312-pytest-9.1.1.pyc\ntests/__pycache__/test_foundation.cpython-312-pytest-9.1.1.pyc\nbin\nbin/test.sh\ndata\ndata/logs\ndata/logs/test_2026-10-14_015406.log\n---\n[project]\nname = \"mdparser\"\nversion = \"0.1.0\"\ndescription = \"CommonMark 0.31.2 parser: stdin Markdown to stdout HTML\"\nrequires-python = \">=3.11\"\ndependencies = []\n\n[dependency-groups]\ndev = [\n    \"pytest\",\n]\n\n[tool.pytest.ini_options]\ntestpaths = [\"tests\"]\npythonpath = [\".\"]\naddopts = \"-ra\"\n# Runtime\ndata/\n*.log\n\n# Environment\n.env\n.venv/\n\n# Python\n__pycache__/\n*.pyc\n*.egg-info/\ndist/\nbuild/\n\n# Tooling\n.pytest_cache/\n\n# OS\n.DS_Store\nThumbs.db\n# mdparser reads no environment variables. The executable runs with no configuration.\n---\n== mdparser/__init__.py\n\"\"\"mdparser: a CommonMark 0.31.2 parser delivered as the stdin-to-stdout `commonmark` executable.\n\nThe package uses only the Python standard library. Its phase-1 block structure and phase-2\ninline structure live in the modules below.\n\"\"\"\n== mdparser/blocks.py\n\"\"\"Phase 1: block tree, block-type registry, per-line procedure, and lazy continuation.\n\nResponsibility: consume lines one at a time, match them against open blocks, look for new block\nstarts, and add remaining text to the deepest open block. Link reference definitions are handed to\n`mdparser.refs` when a paragraph closes.\n\"\"\"\n== mdparser/cli.py\n\"\"\"Process I/O boundary for the `commonmark` executable.\n\nResponsibility: read raw bytes from `sys.stdin.buffer`, decode UTF-8 with U+FFFD replacement,\nnormalize line endings, replace U+0000, and write HTML to `sys.stdout.buffer`. Diagnostics go to\n`sys.stderr` only, and the exit status is 0 for every input.\n\"\"\"\n== mdparser/entities.py\n\"\"\"Character references and backslash escapes.\n\nResponsibility: decode named entities (from the standard library table `html.entities.html5`,\nnames ending in a semicolon only) and numeric character references, and provide the backslash\nunescape helper.\n\"\"\"\n== mdparser/inlines.py\n\"\"\"Phase 2: inline parsing.\n\nResponsibility: parse the raw text of paragraphs and headings into inline nodes with the\ndelimiter-stack algorithms (look for link or image, process emphasis), using the reference map\nfrom `mdparser.refs`.\n\"\"\"\n== mdparser/refs.py\n\"\"\"Link reference definitions: extraction, the document-wide reference map, and `normalize_label`.\n\nResponsibility: extract link reference definitions when a paragraph closes, store them in one\nreference map, and normalize labels with `str.casefold` plus whitespace collapse.\n\"\"\"\n== mdparser/render.py\n\"\"\"HTML rendering.\n\nResponsibility: turn the parsed tree into HTML, escape HTML text and attributes, and\npercent-encode URLs. The conformance runner compares normalized HTML, so tag structure and\nentities must match the spec examples.\n\"\"\"\n---\n__pycache__\nconftest.py\ntest_foundation.py\n#!/bin/bash\n# CommandCenter Operation\n# Name: Run Test Suite\n# Type: batch\n\n# --- Standard Preamble ---\nset -euo pipefail\nSCRIPT_DIR=\"$(cd \"$(dirname \"${BASH_SOURCE[0]}\")\" && pwd)\"\nPROJECT_DIR=\"$(cd \"$SCRIPT_DIR/..\" && pwd)\"\nLOG_DIR=\"$PROJECT_DIR/data/logs\"\nmkdir -p \"$LOG_DIR\"\n\nTIMESTAMP=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d_%H%M%S')\nSCRIPT_NAME=$(basename \"$0\" .sh)\nLOG_FILE=\"$LOG_DIR/${SCRIPT_NAME}_${TIMESTAMP}.log\"\n\necho \"=== $SCRIPT_NAME started at $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') ===\" | tee \"$LOG_FILE\"\necho \"Arguments: $*\" | tee -a \"$LOG_FILE\"\necho \"Working dir: $PROJECT_DIR\" | tee -a \"$LOG_FILE\"\necho \"---\" | tee -a \"$LOG_FILE\"\n\ncd \"$PROJECT_DIR\"\n\n# --- Test Command (pyproject.toml foundation contract: pytest -q, run inside .venv) ---\nif [ ! run_executable(project_root: Path, data: bytes) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes]:\n    return subprocess.run(\n        [str(project_root / \"commonmark\")],\n        input=data,\n        capture_output=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n\n\n# --- Declared acceptance checks (transcribed from FEATURE-Executable.md) ---\n\n\ndef test_executable_empty_input(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC-001: empty stdin gives empty stdout and exit status 0.\"\"\"\n    result = subprocess.run(\n        [str(project_root / \"commonmark\")],\n        input=\"\",\n        capture_output=True,\n        text=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert len(result.stdout) == 0\n\n\ndef test_executable_invalid_utf8(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC-002: invalid UTF-8 bytes are decoded with replacement and the program exits 0.\"\"\"\n    payload = b\"\\xff\\xfe text \\xc3\\x28 end\\n\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, payload)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\")\n\n\ndef test_executable_stdout_is_html_only(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC-003: a normal run exits 0 and its stdout is valid UTF-8 text.\"\"\"\n    source = \"hello world\\n\\nsecond paragraph\\n\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, source.encode(\"utf-8\"))\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\")\n\n\ndef test_executable_line_endings(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"LF, CR and CRLF line endings yield identical output for the same document.\"\"\"\n    lines = \"one\", \"two\", \"\", \"three\"\n    variants = [\"\\n\".join(lines) + \"\\n\", \"\\r\\n\".join(lines) + \"\\r\\n\", \"\\r\".join(lines) + \"\\r\"]\n    outputs = []\n    for source in variants:\n        result = run_executable(project_root, source.encode(\"utf-8\"))\n        assert result.returncode == 0\n        outputs.append(result.stdout)\n    assert outputs[0] == outputs[1] == outputs[2]\n\n\ndef test_executable_nul_replacement(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"U+0000 on input is treated exactly like U+FFFD.\"\"\"\n    with_nul = \"a\\x00b\\n\"\n    with_replacement = \"a�b\\n\"\n    first = run_executable(project_root, with_nul.encode(\"utf-8\"))\n    second = run_executable(project_root, with_replacement.encode(\"utf-8\"))\n    assert first.returncode == 0\n    assert second.returncode == 0\n    assert first.stdout == second.stdout\n\n\n# --- Executable file ---\n\n\ndef test_executable_file_has_execute_bit(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    assert    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout == b\"\"\n\n\ndef test_executable_runs_from_another_working_directory(project_root: Path, tmp_path: Path) -> None:\n    result = subprocess.run(\n        [str(project_root / \"commonmark\")],\n        input=b\"text\\n\",\n        capture_output=True,\n        cwd=tmp_path,\n        check=False,\n    )\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout == b\"\"\n\n\n# --- Decoding ---\n\n\ndef test_decode_source_keeps_valid_utf8() -> None:\n    assert cli.decode_source(\"café ✓\".encode(\"utf-8\")) == cli.split_lines(\"a\\r\\nb\\rc\\nd\") == [\"a\", \"b\", \"c\", \"d\"]\n\n\ndef test_split_lines_trailing_newline_gives_trailing_empty_line() -> None:\n    assert cli.split_lines(\"a\\n\") == [\"a\", test_split_lines_replaces_nul_with_replacement_character() -> None:\n    assert cli.split_lines(\"a\\x00b\") == [\"a�b\"]\n\n\ndef test_split_lines_nul_is_not_a_line_break() -> None:\n    assert test_executable_line_endings(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"LF, CR and CRLF line endings yield identical output for the same document.\"\"\"\n    lines = \"one\", \"two\", \"\", \"three\"\n    variants = [\"\\n\".join(lines) + \"\\n\", \"\\r\\n\".join(lines) + \"\\r\\n\", \"\\r\".join(lines) + \"\\r\"]\n    outputs = []\n    for source in variants:\n        result = run_executable(project_root, source.encode(\"utf-8\"))\n        assert result.returncode == 0\n        outputs.append(result.stdout)\n    assert outputs[0] == outputs[1] == outputs[2]\n\n\ndef test_executable_nul_replacement(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"U+0000 on input is treated exactly like U+FFFD.\"\"\"\n    with_nul = \"a\\x00b\\n\"\n    with_replacement = \"a�b\\n\"\n Diagnostics go to\n`sys.stderr` only, and the exit status is 0 for every input.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport re\nimport sys\n\nREPLACEMENT_CHARACTER = \"�\"\nLINE_ENDING_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"\\r\\n|\\r|\\n\")\n\n\ndef decode_source(data: bytes) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Decode raw input bytes as UTF-8, replacing each invalid byte with U+FFFD.\"\"\"\n    return data.decode(\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\")\n\n\ndef split_lines(text: str) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Split text on LF, CR, or CRLF, and replace each U+0000 with U+FFFD.\"\"\"\n    text = text.replace(\"\\x00\", REPLACEMENT_CHARACTER)\n    return LINE_ENDING_PATTERN.split(text)\n\n\ndef render_lines(lines: list[str]) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Parse the lines and return the HTML document.\n\n    Placeholder until the block engine lands: no blocks are recognized, so the HTML is empty.\n    \"\"\"\n    return \"\"\n\n\ndef main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Run the executable: stdin Markdown to stdout HTML. Always returns 0.\"\"\"\n    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read()\n    try:\n        lines = split_lines(decode_source(data))\n        html = render_lines(lines)\n    except Exception as exc:\n        print(f\"commonmark: internal error: {exc!r}\", file=sys.stderr)\n        html = \"\"\n    sys.stdout.buffer.write(html.encode(\"utf-8\"))\n    sys.stdout.buffer.flush()\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    sys.exit(main())\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":31,"oldLines":7,"newStart":31,"newLines":7,"lines":["     return \"\""," "," ","-def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:","+def main() -> int:","     \"\"\"Run the executable: stdin Markdown to stdout HTML.
